arrival.title: You’ve arrived
arrival.message: You've arrived in Saudi Arabia. Tap to activate your DamDam data — takes 30 seconds.

activation.title: Activate your eSIM
activation.intro: Follow these steps for {{device}}. Keep DamDam open.
activation.placeholderNotice: Device-specific screenshots are being verified on real phones. These generic steps are safe to use now.
activation.loadFailed: Your eSIM details could not load. Please try again.
activation.notConnected: DamDam could not confirm mobile data yet. Check your eSIM is selected, then try again.
activation.failed: Activation could not complete. Use the manual guide instead.

android.openSim: Open SIM cards, Mobile network, or Connections.
android.enable: Select the DamDam eSIM and turn it on.

ios.scanQr: Scan the DamDam QR code shown in the app.
ios.enableData: Turn on the new line for Cellular Data.

compatibility.title: Set up your eSIM
compatibility.supported: Your device supports eSIM. Download it directly, or scan a QR code instead.
compatibility.qrOnly: Use the QR code to activate your DamDam package on a compatible device.
compatibility.warningTitle: Your device may not support eSIM
compatibility.warningBody: Your device does not appear to support eSIM. You can still use your DamDam package by scanning the QR code on a compatible device. Tap Continue to download your QR code, or tap Support to get help.
compatibility.supportMessage: Hi, I need help with my DamDam eSIM setup. Order reference: {{reference}}

qr.queuedFallback: We will retry automatically and notify you when it is ready.
qr.queuedBody: You can leave this screen. We will notify you when your QR code is ready.
qr.installWindow: Install it 2–7 days before your departure.
qr.offlineNote: Keep this QR code saved offline. Open it full-screen, then use your device's Save Image action.

banner.title: Activate eSIM
banner.message: Set up your Saudi Arabia data before you travel.

errors.queued: Download failed. It is queued and will retry automatically.
errors.queuedFallback: Your eSIM is queued for retry.
errors.manualOnly: Use the manual activation guide on this device.
errors.directUnavailable: Direct eSIM download is unavailable on this build.
